span.term: When extraneous load is suppressed, working memory resources are freed and become available to the germane and intrinsic load involved in solving the problem
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: High extraneous load consumes the limited working memory resources, leaving too few for germane load, which is why extraneous load lowers both germane load and the felt probability of success
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: No significant three-way interaction was obtained for cognitive load, which the authors attribute to participants' unfamiliarity with the cognitive-load categories on the self-report questionnaire.
span.note: what this limits: the cognitive-load analysis specifically: THE FAILURE TO OBTAIN A SIGNIFICANT THREE-WAY INTERACTION BY COGNITIVE LOAD INDICATES THAT MORE WORK IS NEEDED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The study is underpowered.
span.note: what this limits: every null in the paper: ANOTHER LIMITATION IS THE POWER OF THE STUDY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Using the tri-split method to define high- and low-prior-knowledge groups discarded the middle third and may have weakened statistical power; a larger sample is needed.
span.note: what this limits: the prior-knowledge grouping: THE CURRENT STUDY USED THE TRI-SPLIT METHODS IN DEFINING HIGH- AND LOW PRIOR KNOWLEDGE LEARNERS WHICH COULD WEAKEN THE POWER - the middle third is discarded and the groups are constructed
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The construct does not order the outcome it is used to explain, and the paper says so in both directions.
span.note: what this limits: reading a cognitive-load score as a predictor of performance: the paper states high load does not necessarily produce low performance and low load does not guarantee good performance
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The whole construct is measured by asking learners, on a single ten-item self-report instrument.
span.note: what this limits: the cognitive-load values in this study: all three types are scored from one 10-item self-report questionnaire on a 0-10 Likert scale
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The design compares immediate effects only, and the authors name retention and transfer as what was not examined.
span.note: what this limits: these results as evidence about learning: the study explored immediate effects, with retention and transfer named as future work
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a control condition whose learners studied the same problems WITHOUT worked examples, against a group shown half the examples first
span.note: eliminates: time on the problems, and exposure to the problem material, as the explanation of the difference - both groups meet the same problems, and only the worked examples differ

span.label: A significant three-way interaction between prior knowledge, worked example and task difficulty was found on posttest performance, but none was found on any type of cognitive load.

span.label: Low-prior-knowledge learners scored higher with full-worked examples while high-prior-knowledge learners scored higher with completion-worked examples, an expertise reversal pattern.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Germane cognitive load was significantly positively correlated with learners' interest in the task.

span.label: Extraneous and germane cognitive load were negatively correlated, confirming the predicted trade-off between them.
